description: Defines classes and methods for managing UE (User Equipment) slices and repositories within a RAN (Radio Access Network) scheduler, including slice_ue and slice_ue_repository classes.

classes.name: slice_ue
classes.description: Represents a UE candidate for scheduling within a specific RAN slice.

classes.name: slice_ue_repository
classes.description: Container managing all UEs belonging to a specific RAN slice.

methods.name: slice_ue
methods.description: Constructor initializing a slice_ue object with UE context, carrier context, and slice ID.

methods.name: get_cc
methods.description: Fetches the UE carrier context managed by this slice.

methods.name: get_lcg_id
methods.description: Fetches the logical channel group associated with a given LCID.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given LCID or LCG ID is part of this slice.

methods.name: has_pending_dl_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Checks if there are DL pending bytes yet to be allocated in DL HARQ.

methods.name: pending_dl_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Computes the number of DL pending bytes for the slice.

methods.name: pending_dl_newtx_bytes(lcid_t)
methods.description: Computes DL pending bytes for a specific LCID.

methods.name: pending_ul_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Computes UL pending bytes in bearers belonging to this slice.

methods.name: pending_ul_unacked_bytes
methods.description: Computes UL bytes yet to be received by the scheduler for a given LCG.

methods.name: has_pending_sr
methods.description: Returns whether a SR indication handling is pending.

methods.name: logical_channels
methods.description: Retrieves QoS information of DRBs configured for the UE.

methods.name: dl_avg_bit_rate
methods.description: Returns the average DL bit rate for a given logical channel.

methods.name: ul_avg_bit_rate
methods.description: Returns the average UL bit rate for a given logical channel group.

methods.name: dl_hol_toa
methods.description: Retrieves the HOL TOA for a given logical channel.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository
methods.description: Manages all UEs belonging to a specific RAN slice, allowing addition, removal, and querying of UEs and bearers.
